description: Show the command catalog or help for one category or command.
scope: The canonical command registry.
authorization: Read-only. With no filter, show all commands grouped by category. With a category or command filter, show only the matching entries. Include usage, description, and effect. Do not invent undocumented commands.

description: Create the smallest effective prompt execution package for Codex or Chat by synthesizing the supplied request with relevant established context from the current conversation.
scope: The supplied target and request plus only the relevant established context from the current conversation needed to make the execution package self-contained and effective.
authorization: Authorize creation of the execution package defined by the selected prompting module and only its required supporting artifacts. For Codex, this command does not authorize repository mutation. Do not mutate external systems, expose hidden reasoning, invent missing state, or include unrelated conversation history.

description: Investigate a scientific or technical question in depth and produce an evidence-led thematic synthesis.
scope: The supplied research question and any scope constraints contained in it.
authorization: Research and synthesize evidence. Do not mutate repositories or permanent knowledge unless separately authorized.

description: Find relevant scientific literature, verify references, and produce a reusable bibliography.
scope: The supplied topic and constraints.
authorization: Search and verify literature and create the bibliography artifacts required by the selected module. Do not modify unrelated repositories or permanent knowledge.

description: Build a comparable state-of-the-art analysis of leading methods, evidence, limitations, maturity, and improvement opportunities.
scope: The supplied topic, comparison target, and constraints.
authorization: Perform evidence-led state-of-the-art analysis. Do not mutate repositories or permanent knowledge unless separately authorized.

description: Read, explain, and critically inspect one identified scientific paper with traceable evidence.
scope: Exactly the supplied paper, DOI, URL, or provided document.
authorization: Read and analyze the identified paper. Working notes may be created only when the selected module requires them; do not alter source repositories or permanent knowledge.

description: Build an interactive self-contained study edition of a LaTeX paper project through one preparation phase, one critical study unit per direct-continuation ok, and a final HTML assembly phase.
scope: Exactly the supplied LaTeX paper project or ZIP and the paper evidence compiled or contained within it.
authorization: Initial invocation performs preparation only. Each direct-continuation response consisting only of ok authorizes at most the next recorded phase. Final delivery may create exactly one self-contained HTML; do not modify the source project or expose auxiliary working files unless explicitly requested.

description: Audit an argument, calculation, or proof step by step and repair it when possible.
scope: The supplied argument, calculation, or proof.
authorization: Read-only reasoning and verification. Do not mutate repositories or permanent knowledge.

description: Construct and validate a rigorous mathematical proof for the supplied statement.
scope: The supplied mathematical statement and assumptions.
authorization: Construct and verify the proof and create only the working proof artifact required by the selected module. Do not modify unrelated repositories or permanent knowledge.

description: Prioritize scientifically publishable and industrially relevant research opportunities.
scope: The supplied field plus optional constraints, resources, time horizon, or goals.
authorization: Assess opportunities and evidence only. Do not claim guaranteed publication or return and do not mutate repositories unless separately authorized.

description: Explain a concept or technology with audience-appropriate depth and optional continuity from explicitly identified research logbooks.
scope: The supplied topic plus audience or purpose information contained in the request or current context.
authorization: Generate the explanation and consult additional evidence only as routed by the selected module. Do not mutate repositories or permanent knowledge.

description: Create structured educational notes or teaching text with the documented pedagogical style.
scope: The supplied topic and optional audience level objective or format constraints.
authorization: Authorize creation of the requested educational content and only the working artifacts required by the selected module. Do not publish externally unless separately authorized.

description: Prepare an educational YouTube video package including the documented master material script metadata and visual-resource plan unless another platform is explicitly requested.
scope: The supplied topic and optional audience level duration or platform context.
authorization: Authorize creation of the educational video artifacts required by the selected module. Do not publish externally and do not generate a likeness of the user without the required supplied image resources.

description: Design a class, session, or training sequence from a topic and optional audience, duration, or delivery constraints.
scope: The supplied topic and optional training context.
authorization: Authorize creation of the master training artifacts required by the selected module. Do not publish or modify unrelated repositories.

description: Design or review a viable undergraduate thesis proposal calibrated to the student's real level and constraints.
scope: The supplied topic and optional student profile or constraints.
authorization: Authorize creation of the proposal Markdown required by the selected module. Do not promise novelty, publication, or unavailable resources.

description: Design or review a viable master's thesis proposal calibrated to the student's real level and constraints.
scope: The supplied topic and optional student profile or constraints.
authorization: Authorize creation of the proposal Markdown required by the selected module. Do not promise novelty, publication, or unavailable resources.

description: Prepare, draft, polish, verify, render mathematical assets, create didactic illustrations, and prepare publication copy for a technical or scientific article through the documented iterative workflow.
scope: The supplied topic, idea, or draft and its intended audience, purpose, constraints, and later direct-continuation corrections when available.
authorization: Initial invocation executes phase 1 only. Each direct-continuation response consisting only of OK authorizes at most the next pending phase defined by the selected workflow. Internal handoff artifacts and publication assets are allowed only when that phase requires them. Do not skip pending phases, drop user requirements, publish externally, or invent work after phase 7.

description: Create or revise a responsive self-contained HTML artifact from the supplied request and any associated Markdown, HTML, or other task files.
scope: The supplied request, including any explicitly stated type or use such as professional, educational, notes, or outreach video, plus Markdown, HTML, references, or other files supplied or clearly associated with the current task.
authorization: Authorize creation or revision of the requested HTML artifact under the selected HTML workflow. Treat an explicitly supplied leading type or use label as a presentation or content hint, not as a separate required field; when the HTML teaches, explains, publishes, or presents subject matter, load only the additional content domain required by the HTML module. Use supplied Markdown or HTML as source or reference material as appropriate. Create only the requested HTML artifact and necessary working files; do not publish externally or modify unrelated repositories.

description: Create a competitive evidence-grounded CV adapted to the supplied job opportunity company or professional context.
scope: The supplied job offer, company, organization, URLs, or professional context, plus only the personal evidence needed for that candidature.
authorization: Authorize creation of the internal Markdown strategy note and the requested CV artifact under the selected module. External research may be used to understand the target. Do not invent experience or capabilities, disclose unnecessary private data, submit applications, send messages, or make unsupported commitments.

description: Adjust the current attached or most recent CV according to the supplied instructions while preserving factual and strategic coherence.
scope: The CV attached or supplied in the current task, or otherwise the most recent clearly established CV in the current conversation, plus the supplied adjustment instructions and any new target context they contain.
authorization: Authorize revision of the selected CV artifact and, when the target changes materially, reconstruction of the internal strategy note required by the selected module. Do not invent facts, broaden capabilities beyond evidence, send applications, or modify unrelated documents.

description: Draft a professional email ready to send using the appropriate personal or corporate workflow and recipient language.
scope: The supplied email thread or drafting context plus relevant current-conversation context.
authorization: Draft only. Select exactly one language branch and the personal or corporate email module from the interactions index. Do not send messages or invent commitments facts availability or institutional authority.

description: Draft a concise LinkedIn response ready to send in the appropriate recipient language.
scope: The supplied LinkedIn message or conversation context plus relevant current-conversation context.
authorization: Draft only. Select exactly one language branch and LinkedIn module from the interactions index. Do not send the message or invent facts commitments or contact data.

description: Draft a first professional contact by email or direct message with a clear purpose and proportionate next step.
scope: The supplied recipient purpose channel and context when available.
authorization: Draft only. Select exactly one language branch and first-contact module from the interactions index. Do not send the message or invent a relationship facts praise availability or commitments.

description: Draft the concise message that accompanies delivery of a promised document link result code or other project material.
scope: The supplied delivery context and the material or commitment being delivered.
authorization: Draft only. Select exactly one language branch and project-delivery module from the interactions index. Do not send the message or claim delivery of material that is not actually available.

description: Draft a professional recommendation letter grounded only in confirmed evidence and the stated opportunity.
scope: The supplied candidate opportunity relationship evidence and recipient context.
authorization: Draft only. Select exactly one language branch and recommendation-letter module from the interactions index. Do not send or sign the letter and do not invent observations comparisons achievements or institutional data.

description: Audit a repository's authorship, licensing, citation, contribution guidance, README, and package metadata for consistency and missing elements.
scope: Exactly the supplied repository.
authorization: Read-only identity audit. Report confirmed files missing elements conflicts and pending decisions; do not modify or publish the repository.

description: Assess whether an existing maintained solution already covers the repository objective and map capability maturity licensing and integration risks.
scope: The supplied repository and optional capability or objective to assess.
authorization: Read-only assessment. Use the external evidence workflow required by the selected module and stop before design or implementation when an integrable existing solution requires a user decision.

description: Review the current scientific manuscript and associated code repository as one evidence set.
scope: Exactly the TeX repository and code repository supplied as arguments.
authorization: Read-only analysis by default. Inspect manuscript and code evidence and produce findings or a revision plan; do not modify, publish, merge, or otherwise mutate either repository unless separately authorized.

description: Assess reviewer or editor comments against the previously submitted manuscript and current manuscript state.
scope: The supplied TeX repository, previous-submission commit, and complete trailing reviewer/editor comments.
authorization: Read-only analysis by default. Evaluate every supplied comment using the selected workflow and propose the smallest credible resolution; do not modify or publish the manuscript unless separately authorized.

description: Prepare a reviewer-ready visual manuscript diff between the submitted and current versions.
scope: The supplied TeX repository and submitted commit; use the supplied current commit or otherwise the repository's current intended manuscript state.
authorization: Authorize creation of independent diff source, build instructions, and reviewer-ready diff artifacts required by the selected module. Do not modify the normal manuscript source or publish changes.

description: Draft a response to reviewers grounded in the submitted and current manuscript evidence.
scope: The supplied TeX repository, submitted commit, and complete reviewer/editor comments.
authorization: Authorize creation of the response-letter artifact required by the selected module. Do not claim unsupported changes or modify or publish the manuscript unless separately authorized.

description: Run a final resubmission-readiness review across manuscript, code, comments, and available response artifacts.
scope: Exactly the supplied TeX repository, code repository, submitted commit, and complete comments.
authorization: Read-only final readiness assessment. Report the workflow verdict and blockers; do not mutate or publish repositories unless separately authorized.

description: Initialize or complete a repository's authorship, licensing, citation, contribution, README, and package identity using verified data.
scope: Exactly the supplied repository.
authorization: Authorize local creation or correction of applicable identity files and metadata under the selected module. Stop for unclear ownership, incompatible licensing, or unverified facts. Do not publish remotely unless separately authorized.

description: Reproduce minimize and evidence one concrete reported repository problem without correcting it.
scope: Exactly the supplied repository and concrete problem description, including only the code, configuration, tests, fixtures, environment facts, and execution path needed to reproduce that problem.
authorization: Authorize bounded local reproduction work and, when materially useful, creation of the smallest focused regression test, reproduction harness, or fixture needed to demonstrate the supplied problem. Do not fix production behavior, do not broaden into a general bug audit, do not publish or mutate remote state, and do not claim reproduction without direct observed evidence.

description: Refactor a bounded repository scope for readability and maintainability without changing external contracts.
scope: Exactly the supplied repository and optional scope; when omitted, identify the highest-value bounded refactoring target without expanding into a rewrite.
authorization: Authorize local refactoring and verification under the selected module. Preserve public behavior and unrelated work; do not publish remotely unless separately authorized.

description: Update technical repository documentation for the supplied objective and verified implementation state.
scope: Exactly the supplied repository and documentation objective.
authorization: Authorize local documentation changes and their verification. Do not publish remotely unless separately authorized.

description: Prepare a repository's current development work so it is technically ready for publication or integration.
scope: Exactly the supplied repository and its current task-related work.
authorization: Authorize local readiness work, checks, coherent commits, and bounded corrections required by the selected module. Do not push, open or merge pull requests, or otherwise mutate GitHub.
